title: Activity Audit: advanced search, saved queries, and bulk download for admins
creator: Sana Patel
description: Provide administrators and security engineers with a powerful activity/audit log experience in the Console that supports complex filtering, saved queries/bookmarks, cursor-based pagination for large result sets, and bulk export to CSV/NDJSON with row-level redaction rules tied to RBAC v2. This ticket covers the UX and API contract for search+export, the server-side export job orchestration, and the minimum access controls required to prevent unauthorized bulk extraction.
acceptance_criteria: Admins with the 'audit.viewer' or 'audit.admin' RBAC role can run ad-hoc queries using filters: actor, action, resource_type, resource_id, time_range, outcome, ip, region, and metadata.key:value
Users can save a query as a named 'bookmark' (saved query) with a description; saved queries appear in a 'Saved searches' sidebar and are editable by the creator and by users with 'audit.admin' role
Search results support cursor-based pagination (opaque cursor token) and stable ordering by timestamp desc, with consistent results across pages even under concurrent writes
Bulk export endpoint accepts a saved-query-id or ad-hoc query JSON and enqueues an export job; job returns a download URL when ready (signed, time-limited)
Exports support CSV and NDJSON formats; CSV follows a canonical header order and NDJSON emits one JSON event per line using the public audit schema v2
Exported data respects redaction policy: PII fields (user.email, user_ip when flagged, request.headers.Authorization) are redacted or removed depending on role-based redaction rules

RBAC enforcement: only roles with explicit 'audit.export' permission can request exports larger than 10k rows; smaller ad-hoc downloads (<=10k rows) are allowed for 'audit.viewer' but tracked separately
API and Console show quota/usage and estimated export size before enqueueing large jobs
Server-side job supports streaming generation to object storage with backpressure to avoid OOM on large exports
Telemetry: track search latency percentiles, export job time, bytes produced, and number of redacted fields per export
implementation_notes: Frontend: add 'Saved searches' component in left rail with create/edit/delete and share controls; modal for 'Export results' to select format and retention
Backend: new /v1/audit/search and /v1/audit/export endpoints; /export creates an ExportJob resource persisted in jobs DB with status lifecycle: pending->running->ready->failed
Cursor pagination: return {items: [...], next_cursor: "...", estimated_total: optional} where cursor is HMAC-signed with server key and encodes last_seen_timestamp and last_item_id
Export streaming: generator reads search cursor windows, applies redaction on the fly, writes to temporary S3 path using multipart upload, then finalizes and issues signed URL
Redaction: configurable policy by field path; default policy uses allowlist + redact for sensitive fields. Policy is evaluated at job runtime with user role context
Access control hooks: integrate with RBAC v2 enforcement middleware; export job creation checks 'audit.export' permission and applies size limits
Rate limiting: export requests are subject to tenant-level concurrency caps and per-account request rate checks; enforce via token bucket backed by Redis
Pagination under retention tombstones: if events are deleted during a paged scan, cursors must skip missing entries and record warning counts in metadata
ui_notes: Search bar with advanced filter builder: + add filter button that supports AND/OR groups and exact vs fuzzy matching
Preview pane should show sample of first 50 rows with column chooser; CSV header preview when user requests export
Saved query UX: name, description, visibility (private/team/org), last run timestamp, owner; quick actions: run, export, share link, pin
Export modal: format selector (CSV / NDJSON), redaction level dropdown (full | partial | none), max rows cap input with warning, email notification toggle
Console should display estimated job size and ETA (very rough) before submit, and show progress updates after creation
Errors must be user-friendly: for permission denied include link to RBAC help doc and list required role(s)
backend_notes: Re-use the common audit-search index (Elasticsearch or Bigtable) with a thin query planner that converts Console filters to optimized index queries
Implement ExportJob worker pool that streams results to object storage; workers must checkpoint progress for retry and resume
Use object storage lifecycle rules to auto-expire exports after configurable retention (default 7 days)
Implement exporter metrics (per-job counters) and integrate into Console job status view via status endpoint
Ensure all export payloads are encrypted at rest and signed in transit; leverage customer KMS for Private deployments when present
api_contract: POST /v1/audit/search -> {query: string|filters, limit: int, cursor: string|null} returns {items: [AuditEvent], next_cursor: string|null}
POST /v1/audit/export -> {query: filters|saved_query_id, format: 'csv'|'ndjson', redaction: 'full'|'partial'|'none', notify_email: optional, max_rows: optional} returns {job_id: string}
GET /v1/audit/export/{job_id} -> {status: string, progress: number, download_url: optional, errors: optional}
GET /v1/audit/saved_queries -> list and permissions; POST /v1/audit/saved_queries to create
All endpoints return 403 when RBAC check fails and include required permission scopes in response header X-Required-Permissions
test_cases: Query filters: verify results for combinations of actor + resource_type + time_range + metadata match
Pagination stability: create new events mid-scan and assert that cursor pages do not duplicate or skip incorrect records
Export redaction: create events with PII and assert exported CSV/NDJSON respect redaction levels for different roles
Permission boundaries: verify 'audit.viewer' cannot create export jobs >10k rows but 'audit.export' can
Error handling: simulate worker failure and verify retry behavior and final failed job state with meaningful message
Performance: end-to-end search latency P95 < 750ms for queries returning <=500 rows; large export throughput target of 200MB/min per worker
performance_targets: Interactive search (<=500 rows): median latency < 200ms, P95 < 750ms
Search API burst QPS support: 100 reqs/sec across region for Console usage patterns
Export job creation to job-running transition < 5s for queued jobs under normal load
Export worker throughput: >= 200MB/min streaming with 8GB RAM worker
Cursor pagination page generation < 500ms for pages of 1000 rows
migration_plan: Phase 1: API + backend job prototype behind feature flag in staging; limited to internal accounts
Phase 2: Frontend saved-saves UI and export modal rollout to beta orgs; collect telemetry and iterate
Phase 3: RBAC policy tuning; expose 'audit.export' permission to org admins and document
Phase 4: Gradual rollout with export size caps and monitoring; enable for all orgs after 2 weeks of stable telemetry
